title: Existing buildings within the fire district.
officialText:
An existing building shall not hereafter be increased in height or area
unless it is of a type of construction permitted for new buildings within the fire district or is altered to comply with the
requirements for such type of construction. Nor shall any existing building be hereafter extended on any side, nor square
footage or floors added within the existing building unless such modifications are of a type of construction permitted for
new buildings within the fire district.
